    <title>v29.8.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>29.8.1</h2>
<p>For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.1">docker/cli, 29.8.1 milestone</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.1">moby/moby, 29.8.1 milestone</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug fixes and enhancements</h3>
<ul>
<li>containerd image store: Fix <code>docker load</code> leaving dangling images after loading an image that already exists. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53595" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53595/hovercard">moby/moby#53595</a></li>
<li>Fix managed containerd logging a CRI pod-sandbox plugin dependency warning during startup. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53585" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53585/hovercard">moby/moby#53585</a></li>
<li>Fix user-namespace detection on OpenVZ, where namespace inode numbers are virtualized. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53605" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53605/hovercard">moby/moby#53605</a></li>
<li>Windows: Preserve hard links when committing a container, so a file with multiple names is stored once in the resulting image layer instead of once per name. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53624" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53624/hovercard">moby/moby#53624</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Packaging updates</h3>
<ul>
<li>Update containerd (static binaries) to <a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.5">v2.3.5</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53589" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53589/hovercard">moby/moby#53589</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Networking</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>GET /networks</code> returning a 500 status if an invalid 'type' filter was provided. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53678" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53678/hovercard">moby/moby#53678</a></li>
</ul></content>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/7691631/docker-v29.8.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-03T22:31:49Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.8.0"/>
    <title>v29.8.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>29.8.0</h2>
<p>For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.0">docker/cli, 29.8.0 milestone</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.0">moby/moby, 29.8.0 milestone</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>New</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>HostConfig.Umask</code> option and a corresponding <code>--umask &lt;octal&gt;</code> flag to <code>docker create</code>/<code>docker run</code> to set the umask for a container's main process, execs, and healthchecks. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53463/hovercard">moby/moby#53463</a>, <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7108" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7108/hovercard">docker/cli#7108</a></li>
<li>Add support for attaching service names, environments, and custom CloudWatch entity attributes to logs from the <code>awslogs</code> logging driver. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52632" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52632/hovercard">moby/moby#52632</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Security</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add daemon support for configuring the default container AppArmor profile template. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52771" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52771/hovercard">moby/moby#52771</a>
<ul>
<li>See <a href="https://docker.docker.com/engine/security/apparmor/#customize-the-default-profile" rel="nofollow">https://docker.docker.com/engine/security/apparmor/#customize-the-default-profile</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Prevent containers from using the 32-bit <code>socketcall(2)</code> path to create <code>AF_VSOCK</code> sockets and communicate with host virtual machines by adding AppArmor and SELinux policy rules. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53551" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53551/hovercard">moby/moby#53551</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Networking</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>docker network inspect</code> failing to find a healthy Swarm network when another Swarm network could not be allocated. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53325" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53325/hovercard">moby/moby#53325</a></li>
<li>Fix a node gossiping a superseded value for a Swarm service discovery entry after concurrent updates to the same key. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53479" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53479/hovercard">moby/moby#53479</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service names failing to resolve on a node indefinitely after it misses a network membership announcement. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53437" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53437/hovercard">moby/moby#53437</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service names failing to resolve on healthy nodes after a transient node failure. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53142" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53142/hovercard">moby/moby#53142</a></li>
<li>Prevent dockerd from hanging when the nft command produces enough stderr output to fill its pipe. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53517" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53517/hovercard">moby/moby#53517</a></li>
<li>Reduce gossip traffic generated by a node that repeatedly disconnects and rejoins the cluster. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53479" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53479/hovercard">moby/moby#53479</a></li>
<li>Remote network-driver plugins can now set the container-side interface name via the <code>DstName</code> field in their <code>Join</code> response. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52866" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52866/hovercard">moby/moby#52866</a></li>
<li>Reserve network names "container" and "container:" to prevent creation of unusable networks. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/51973" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/51973/hovercard">moby/moby#51973</a></li>
<li>Spread the daemon's periodic Swarm overlay network gossip and synchronization work over time, avoiding recurring bursts of CPU and network usage. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53475" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53475/hovercard">moby/moby#53475</a></li>
<li>Swarm service-mesh published ports now use the same infrastructure as published ports for local containers. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53118" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53118/hovercard">moby/moby#53118</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Rootless</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>--disable-host-loopback</code> not being enforced for the <code>pasta</code> network driver in rootless mode. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53358" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53358/hovercard">moby/moby#53358</a></li>
<li>Update RootlessKit to v3.1.0, adding support for the <code>pesto</code> port driver in rootless mode. Set <code>DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_PORT_DRIVER=pesto</code> to use it; it requires the <code>pasta</code> network driver and supports IPv4 only. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53358" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53358/hovercard">moby/moby#53358</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Go SDK</h3>
<ul>
<li>Update minimum supported Go version to 1.26. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7258" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7258/hovercard">docker/cli#7258</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug fixes and enhancements</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>annotation</code> filter to container listings (<code>docker ps</code>, <code>GET /containers/json</code>) allowing to filter containers by their annotations. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53538" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53538/hovercard">moby/moby#53538</a></li>
<li>containerd image store: Fix <code>docker image inspect</code> reporting a smaller image size than <code>docker image ls</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53426" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53426/hovercard">moby/moby#53426</a></li>
<li>containerd image store: Fix slower image pulls caused by repeated registry authentication within a single pull. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53497" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53497/hovercard">moby/moby#53497</a></li>
<li>Do not log expected image signature identity misses as errors for containerd image store images. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53495" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53495/hovercard">moby/moby#53495</a></li>
<li>dockerd now uses the embedded containerd if no system containerd service is configured and containerd is not installed. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53388" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53388/hovercard">moby/moby#53388</a></li>
<li>Fix <code>GET /images/{name}/json</code> not including unpacked snapshot usage in <code>Size</code> when using the containerd image store. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53426" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53426/hovercard">moby/moby#53426</a></li>
<li>Fix classic-builder cache for Dockerfile stages that select a non-host platform with <code>FROM --platform</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53503" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53503/hovercard">moby/moby#53503</a></li>
<li>Fix CLI panic when <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> or <code>-H</code> specifies an invalid host. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7280" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7280/hovercard">docker/cli#7280</a></li>
<li>Fix health checks being delayed for too long when the start interval is longer than the start period. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52317" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52317/hovercard">moby/moby#52317</a></li>
<li>Fix inconsistent mount ordering in <code>docker inspect</code> output (<code>GET /containers/{id}/json</code>) and container listings (<code>docker ps</code>, <code>GET /containers/json</code>). <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53534" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53534/hovercard">moby/moby#53534</a></li>
<li>Fix NRI container metadata so <code>Container.Args</code> includes the resolved executable as <code>argv[0]</code>, matching the process launched in the container instead of only the Docker <code>Cmd</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53423" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53423/hovercard">moby/moby#53423</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service creation failing when an automatically generated name is already in use. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53468" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53468/hovercard">moby/moby#53468</a></li>
<li>Fix the container root directory <code>/</code> being world-writable when using the <code>btrfs</code> storage driver. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53500" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53500/hovercard">moby/moby#53500</a></li>
<li>Fixed <code>docker ps</code> sorting published ports lexicographically instead of numerically. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7144" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7144/hovercard">docker/cli#7144</a></li>
<li>Preserve service mount order during forced updates to avoid an unnecessary rollout on the next stack deploy. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7227" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7227/hovercard">docker/cli#7227</a></li>
<li>Prevent containerd's v2 CRI plugins from loading when CRI is disabled. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53564" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53564/hovercard">moby/moby#53564</a></li>
<li>Print plugin hook output (e.g. the "What's next:" hint) after the command's error message instead of before it. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/6976" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/6976/hovercard">docker/cli#6976</a></li>
<li>Reject checkpoint IDs containing path separators to prevent access outside the container checkpoint directory. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53377" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53377/hovercard">moby/moby#53377</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Packaging updates</h3>
<ul>
<li>Update BuildKit to <a href="https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.33.0">v0.33.0</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53554/hovercard">moby/moby#53554</a></li>
<li>Update containerd (static binaries) to <a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.4">v2.3.4</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53409" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53409/hovercard">moby/moby#53409</a></li>
<li>Update Go runtime to <a href="https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.8" rel="nofollow">1.26.8</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53550" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53550/hovercard">moby/moby#53550</a>, <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7274" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7274/hovercard">docker/cli#7274</a></li>
<li>Update runc (in static binaries) to <a href="https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/releases/tag/v1.5.1">v1.5.1</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52306" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52306/hovercard">moby/moby#52306</a></li>
</ul></content>

    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/client%2Fv0.6.0"/>
    <title>client/v0.6.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>0.6.0</h2>
<h3>Changelog</h3>
<ul>
<li>pkg/jsonmessage: add new WithMessagePrinter option to use a custom printer for messages. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53489" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53489/hovercard">moby/moby#53489</a></li>
<li>api: Bump to 1.56. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53425" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53425/hovercard">moby/moby#53425</a></li>
<li>minor cleanups, refactors. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53509" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53509/hovercard">moby/moby#53509</a></li>
</ul></content>
    <author>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/7691631/api/v1.56.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-03T20:43:14Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/api%2Fv1.56.0"/>
    <title>api/v1.56.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.56.0</h2>
<h3>Changelog</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>GET /containers/json</code> now supports an <code>annotation</code> filter to filter containers by annotation, either by key (<code>annotation=key</code>) or by key and value (<code>annotation="key=value"</code>), similar to the existing <code>label</code> filter. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53538" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53538/hovercard">moby/moby#53538</a></li>
<li><code>POST /containers/create</code> now supports <code>HostConfig.Umask</code> to set the initial umask for a Unix container. When set, the daemon includes the value in the OCI process configuration for the container's entrypoint, exec processes, and healthchecks. When omitted, the runtime's default behavior applies.<a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53463/hovercard">moby/moby#53463</a></li>
<li>api/docs: sync API docs v1.25 - v1.55. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53246" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53246/hovercard">moby/moby#53246</a></li>
<li>api/swagger: Align Healthcheck name with Go struct. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53567" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53567/hovercard">moby/moby#53567</a></li>
<li>api/types/plugin: Deprecated <code>plugin.Privileges</code> sorting methods in favor of <code>slices.SortFunc</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53511" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53511/hovercard">moby/moby#53511</a></li>
<li>api/types/plugin: fix Privileges Swap implementation. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53510" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53510/hovercard">moby/moby#53510</a></li>
<li>api: Bump to 1.56. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53425" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53425/hovercard">moby/moby#53425</a></li>
<li>api: document Task.NetworksAttachments in the swagger definition. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53082" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53082/hovercard">moby/moby#53082</a></li>
<li>api: remove gotest.tools from tests. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53535" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53535/hovercard">moby/moby#53535</a></li>
<li>api: swagger: Use int64 for build query params. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53520/hovercard">moby/moby#53520</a></li>
<li>api: use blackbox testing. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53525" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53525/hovercard">moby/moby#53525</a></li>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/7691631/docker-v29.8.0-rc.1</id>
    <updated>2026-08-28T20:48:41Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.8.0-rc.1"/>
    <title>v29.8.0-rc.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>29.8.0-rc.1</h2>
<p>For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.0">docker/cli, 29.8.0 milestone</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.8.0">moby/moby, 29.8.0 milestone</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug fixes and enhancements</h3>
<ul>
<li>containerd image store: Fix <code>docker image inspect</code> reporting a smaller image size than <code>docker image ls</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53426" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53426/hovercard">moby/moby#53426</a></li>
<li>Do not log expected image signature identity misses as errors for containerd image store images. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53495" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53495/hovercard">moby/moby#53495</a></li>
<li>dockerd now uses the embedded containerd if no system containerd service is configured and containerd is not installed. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53388" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53388/hovercard">moby/moby#53388</a></li>
<li>Fix <code>GET /images/{name}/json</code> not including unpacked snapshot usage in <code>Size</code> when using the containerd image store. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53426" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53426/hovercard">moby/moby#53426</a></li>
<li>Fix NRI container metadata so <code>Container.Args</code> includes the resolved executable as <code>argv[0]</code>, matching the process launched in the container instead of only the Docker <code>Cmd</code>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53423" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53423/hovercard">moby/moby#53423</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service creation failing when an automatically generated name is already in use. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53468" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53468/hovercard">moby/moby#53468</a></li>
<li>Fixed <code>docker ps</code> sorting published ports lexicographically instead of numerically. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7144" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7144/hovercard">docker/cli#7144</a></li>
<li>Reject checkpoint IDs containing path separators to prevent access outside the container checkpoint directory. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53377" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53377/hovercard">moby/moby#53377</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Packaging updates</h3>
<ul>
<li>Update BuildKit to <a href="https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.33.0-rc1">v0.33.0-rc1</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53476" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53476/hovercard">moby/moby#53476</a></li>
<li>Update containerd (static binaries) to <a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.4">v2.3.4</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53409" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53409/hovercard">moby/moby#53409</a></li>
<li>Update Go runtime to <a href="https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.7" rel="nofollow">1.26.7</a>. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7224" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7224/hovercard">docker/cli#7224</a>, <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53413" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53413/hovercard">moby/moby#53413</a></li>
<li>Update runc (in static binaries) to <a href="https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/releases/tag/v1.5.1">v1.5.1</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52306" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52306/hovercard">moby/moby#52306</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Networking</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>docker network inspect</code> failing to find a healthy Swarm network when another Swarm network could not be allocated. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53325" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53325/hovercard">moby/moby#53325</a></li>
<li>Fix a node gossiping a superseded value for a Swarm service discovery entry after concurrent updates to the same key. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53479" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53479/hovercard">moby/moby#53479</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service names failing to resolve on a node indefinitely after it misses a network membership announcement. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53437" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53437/hovercard">moby/moby#53437</a></li>
<li>Fix Swarm service names failing to resolve on healthy nodes after a transient node failure. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53142" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53142/hovercard">moby/moby#53142</a></li>
<li>Reduce gossip traffic generated by a node that repeatedly disconnects and rejoins the cluster. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53479" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53479/hovercard">moby/moby#53479</a></li>
<li>Remote network-driver plugins can now set the container-side interface name via the <code>DstName</code> field in their <code>Join</code> response. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52866" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/52866/hovercard">moby/moby#52866</a></li>
<li>Reserve network names "container" and "container:" to prevent creation of unusable networks. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/51973" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/51973/hovercard">moby/moby#51973</a></li>
<li>Spread the daemon's periodic Swarm overlay network gossip and synchronization work over time, avoiding recurring bursts of CPU and network usage. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53475" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53475/hovercard">moby/moby#53475</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Rootless</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>--disable-host-loopback</code> not being enforced for the <code>pasta</code> network driver in rootless mode. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53358" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53358/hovercard">moby/moby#53358</a></li>
<li>Update RootlessKit to v3.1.0, adding support for the <code>pesto</code> port driver in rootless mode. Set <code>DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_PORT_DRIVER=pesto</code> to use it; it requires the <code>pasta</code> network driver and supports IPv4 only. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53358" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53358/hovercard">moby/moby#53358</a></li>
</ul></content>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/7691631/docker-v29.7.2</id>
    <updated>2026-08-06T10:35:19Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.7.2"/>
    <title>v29.7.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>29.7.2</h2>
<p>For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.7.2">docker/cli, 29.7.2 milestone</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.7.2">moby/moby, 29.7.2 milestone</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug fixes and enhancements</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix <code>docker service create</code> and <code>docker service update</code> panicking when the same environment variable is passed more than once. <a href="https://github.com/docker/cli/pull/7145" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/docker/cli/pull/7145/hovercard">docker/cli#7145</a></li>
<li>Fix a regression introduced in Docker Engine 29.7.0 that caused image pulls to reject images containing absolute hardlink targets, as produced by some image builders. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53305" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53305/hovercard">moby/moby#53305</a></li>
<li>Fix a regression introduced in Docker Engine 29.7.0 that could cause image pulls and <code>docker cp</code> to fail on older Linux kernels when applying file permissions, including for device nodes. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53305" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53305/hovercard">moby/moby#53305</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Packaging updates</h3>
<ul>
<li>Update BuildKit to <a href="https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.32.2">v0.32.2</a>. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53300" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53300/hovercard">moby/moby#53300</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Networking</h3>
<ul>
<li>Improve compatibility with more nftables releases by terminating base-chain policies with a semicolon. <a href="https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53303" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/moby/moby/pull/53303/hovercard">moby/moby#53303</a></li>
</ul></content>
